amount.note: The fee schedule lists a $100 filing fee plus a $10 charge, $110 in total, for online and paper filing.

annual.label: Annual registration
annual.due: Between January 1 and April 1 each year, starting the year after the LLC is formed.

amount.note: The Division lists $60: a $50 filing fee plus a $10 service charge. The first registration is due in the calendar year after formation.

notIncluded.label: Late annual registration penalty
notIncluded.reason: Only if the annual registration is filed after April 1. The fee schedule lists a flat penalty.

notIncluded.label: Registered agent service
notIncluded.reason: Only if you hire a registered agent. The agent sets the price, so it is not a state fee and is not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Name reservation
notIncluded.reason: Optional. Reserving a name before you file is a separate charge and is not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Expedited filing and certified copies
notIncluded.reason: Optional. Faster processing and certified copies cost extra and are not in the total.

notIncluded.label: Local business licenses and permits
notIncluded.reason: City, county and industry licenses depend on where the business operates and what it does. None are in the total.

notIncluded.label: Federal and state income taxes
notIncluded.reason: Taxes on the LLC's or its owners' income are not part of this estimate. This page is not legal or tax advice.

content.intro: {state} charges a one-time fee to file Articles of Organization and a small annual registration fee each year after that.

howItWorks.text: The Corporations Division fee schedule lists the filing fee for Articles of Organization as a base fee plus a service charge. The estimate uses the total.
Every LLC files an annual registration between the start of January and the start of April. The first one is due in the calendar year after the LLC is formed.

faq.q: When is the first {state} annual registration due?
faq.text: In the calendar year after the LLC is formed, between the start of January and the start of April.
